reveals.label: What that session was getting at

content.text: Keeping your guard is keeping a boundary between you and the other person. The mask does the same job socially. Retention on the mat and the performed self are two versions of the same guard.

slides.title: Closed Guard Opening, Hands on Body

body.text: Now you are the one trying to get past. Win by opening the guard: hands on the body, break it down, clear the feet. Light pressure only, nobody gets crushed.
This is where the guard, the mask, starts getting beaten.

content.text: Take the base first, destabilize before advancing.
Card: Controlling the Legs. Domain: Enter.

reveals.label: Still true every session: the tap

content.text: Any of the three ends the round immediately. When your partner taps, you stop. Not after you finish the move. Immediately.
